title: Quick Tips: Find a Field on a Business Central Page
summary: Page Inspection is a built-in tool in Business Central that helps you quickly find and locate specific fields on any page without scrolling through tabs. You can search for fields by name and the page automatically highlights their location, also revealing field numbers and data types needed for AL coding.
key_points: Use Ctrl+Alt+F1 or Help & Support menu to open Page Inspection pane on the right side
Search for fields by name in the Table Fields tab and Business Central highlights where they appear on the page
View field names, numbers, and data types simultaneously, useful for AL development
Only fields visible on the page get highlighted; table fields not displayed return no highlight
Permission restrictions may limit visibility of certain field details in the inspection pane
